title: limonium delicatulum subsp. retusum
intro: Limonium delicatulum subsp. retusum, commonly known as Sea Lavender or Small Sea Lavender, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Plumbaginaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Limonium delicatulum subsp. retusum are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, calm the nervous system, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
